verdict.rationale: Extend's data-handling docs describe automatic retention policies that can be configured to fit the customer's policy, zero-data-retention options (including ZDR with AI subprocessors, set at the workspace level and for the Parse APIs), and deletion APIs for every resource. Pricing also lists zero data retention. Together these cover both retention control and deletion. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that retention configuration and deletion APIs work as documented, and detailed per-endpoint deletion docs in the pack.
